_meta.name: structural_equation_model
_meta.description: A confirmatory factor analysis of the six-item rating battery on survey.pulse (q1..q6), written in lavaan / semopy syntax: service =~ q1 + q2 + q3 and value =~ q4 + q5 + q6, the two factors free to correlate. The default setup reproduces semopy's semopy.Model(desc).fit(data): its SLSQP fit at ftol 1e-6, its standard errors and its calc_stats fit indices, early stop included. auxiliary.estimates is semopy's inspect table (q2 ~ service is a loading; service ~~ value the factor covariance; q1's loading is fixed to 1, so it has no standard error); scalars carry the chi-square with its p, CFI, TLI, RMSEA, AIC and BIC. q3 and q6 cross-load in the data, so the chi-square flags misfit and residual_covariance shows where. The second spec converges to the optimum with solver fisher and the cheaper rank2 derivatives. Streamable and mergeable.
